svg.text: FESTIVAL OF TRADITIONAL SPORTS · UNIVERSAL QR LIVE HUB · UI/UX SPECIFICATION
A 3D event map. The site does not know where the QR was scanned, so there is no "You are here". The visitor
picks the location they want to inspect.

g.text: Select a location to see what is on there.
Wrestling and combat demonstrations on a 12 m mat.

svg.text: Isometric map of all zones. Live locations carry a red dot;
the selected location rises and glows.
Tap a block to select it
Title reads EVENT MAP, never "You are here"
Main Arena, Traditional Sports Zone, Cultural Zone, FOP 1–3,
Registration, Food, Medical, Information, Transport, Toilets,
What is happening at the selected location right now.
The next sessions at this location only.
The full day at this location with statuses.
Upcoming sessions of similar disciplines elsewhere on site.
Selection is manual; location is never assumed.
Mockup content is illustrative. Countries, sports, times and venues are managed in Admin and update live on the public site.
